resources.string: This looks like the way scammers work:
Hang up if someone is telling you what to do. Your guardian has been told. Banks and police never ask you to pay or share a code on a call.
You can continue now if you are sure.
Your guardian has released this pause.
Your guardians are told if something looks like a scam. Tap to change settings.

Co-Sign family protection notices when a bank, payment or email sign-in screen opens during a call with an unknown number, when a chat app is opened right after a one-time code arrives, or when screen sharing is about to start, and pauses it so you can check first. It only sees what kind of screen is open. It never reads what is on the screen or what you type.
Your guardian paused this phone for a few minutes.
Ask my guardian to let me continue
Your guardian has been asked. Please wait for them to call you.
Could not reach your guardian. Call them yourself on a number you know.
Lets Co-Sign tell your guardian when the wrong screen-lock PIN is entered many times, and lets your guardian lock the screen in an emergency. Co-Sign cannot erase the phone or change your PIN.
